privacy: Neutral invented commands and folders only; no config contents, tokens or personal paths in tests or logs.
title: Owner: the files tool is no longer suspended on NERV-01 after the update
goal: After the lifecycle update NERV-01 starts the files MCP server and files.read_text_file is granted, not suspended
acceptance: After the update, `nerv doctor | grep -A4 '"mcp"'` shows files with a tool count and no error
The dashboard tool list shows files.read_text_file without "suspended" (allow a minute for the listing to refresh); if it says its description changed, run `nerv tools grant` for it again
validation: Owner check, recorded in B-148 Verification
escalation: The agent records the result; a remaining failure reopens B-148-T02

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one doctor run and a look at the dashboard. Not a measurement.
